answer: Each Sybil node must post stake S with quadratic slashing erosion S^2/k, so cluster cost grows n^2 while extractable value is bounded by nV. At the marginal node, incremental capital exceeds V by factor (2n/kS - 1). This inequality holds for n above threshold N = kV/(2S), letting shale, quill, and wharf liquidity sinks lock capital and make attacks uneconomic.
